top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks combine a sharply identifiable magic-wavelength principle with decisive experimental realization, exceptional independent reproducibility, and an unusually compact, proportionate attribution to Katori and Ye. They constitute a mature and durable expansion of precision measurement whose citation can exclude later performance gains and applications.
recusal_note: No specific personal, collaborative, or institutional connection to Hidetoshi Katori or Jun Ye is apparent from my profile. My quantum-optics and precision-measurement work provides technical familiarity but no identified conflict.
